activation: Disabled at user request. Shipping builds compile inert diagnostic APIs: no worker, event collection, persistence, pairing or transport. Historical security proof does not enable production. Cloudflare ingestion remains disabled.
portability_review: Apple isolated host fixtures use weak fallback definitions because Mach-O requires link-time resolution even for missing weak imports. Both TV targets retain the identical ELF weak declaration and runtime. Focused host validation includes a real strong-provider override check; no diagnostic event, consent, transport or storage changes.
retry_lock_review: Confirmed race: worker attempt reservation was outside mu while Send read attempts under mu. Reserve the count/deadline under mu, keep IO outside it. The real C fixture asserts mutex ownership at reservation. No protocol, consent, endpoint, storage format or backend behavior changed. Require focused native fixture passes and full release gates for this revision.
regression_portability_review: Darwin feature declarations restored for mkdtemp. Private UI icon token is unchanged and separated from translated text. Settings persistence fixture now tests fresh-recipient consent (legacy migration/default/off/on isolation, explicit default-decline UI, on/off persistence and real worker restart) instead of wrongly requiring upstream automatic opt-in. No client transport, backend, consent implementation or queue behavior changed; require focused macOS and full release gates.
disabled_release_review: NV_DIAG_VERIFIED=0 now compiles inert APIs and observer hooks. TV upload/pairing controls are removed with enum indices retained; manual/consent entry points stay closed. Existing diagnostics regression fixtures explicitly compile the retained implementation separately; a new disabled fixture links without any filesystem/network/thread providers and checks every API remains inert. Both platform full release gates remain mandatory.
